science_relevance.scientific_problem: Minimize the length of a tour that visits each location once and returns to its start.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Shorter feasible tours address routing, inspection and manufacturing movement costs. The local instances are bounded algorithmic studies of that operations-research objective, not evidence of a deployed logistics improvement.

papers.primary_goal: Compute optimal or near-optimal traveling-salesman tours efficiently.
